claim.en: According to a 2018 Pravda profile, Jozef Mičo studied at the Dubnica Technological Institute and started a construction business in 1992.
claim.sk: Podľa profilu Pravdy z roku 2018 Jozef Mičo vyštudoval Dubnický technologický inštitút a v roku 1992 začal podnikať v stavebníctve.

findings.identity: Terchová native (born 1963 in Terchová), set builder from Terchová named in article.
